style: Photorealistic lifestyle photography, soft warm natural daylight, clean modern Singapore apartment interior with warm sage green, olive and cream textiles, gentle morning light, shallow depth of field, high detail fur texture, no text no watermark.

images.alt: Adult toy Maltipoo standing next to a Maltipoo puppy showing size difference

images.alt: Tiny toy Maltipoo puppy held gently in two hands showing its small size
